2607.09598.title: Tokenizer Transplantation: Mitigating Autoregressive Collapse in Edge-Efficient Bengali ASR
2607.09598.paper_summary: Lightweight speech recognition models are critical for edge deployment, yet highly optimized architectures like Moonshine often fail on morphologically rich, non-Latin languages such as Bengali. This study identifies the root cause of this failure as the model's English-centric byte-level tokenizer, which fragments Bengali words into high-fertility byte chains and triggers catastrophic autoregressive collapse during inference. To resolve this, a novel vocabulary transplantation pipeline is proposed to replace the decoder vocabulary with the native-script BanglaBERT WordPiece vocabulary and resize the corresponding token embedding matrix. Experimental results demonstrate a reduction in token fertility from 9.16 to 1.30. By decreasing autoregressive sequence length by 85.8%, decoding instability is entirely mitigated. When evaluated on the 882-hour Lipi-Ghor dataset, the modified architecture achieves a competitive 21.54% Word Error Rate (WER) and a Real-Time Factor (RTF) of 0.0053. Ultimately, this research provides a scalable, reproducible blueprint for cross-script adaptation of compact ASR models without the need for resource-intensive pre-training.
2607.09598.paper_summary_zh: 輕量級語音識別模型對於邊緣部署至關重要，然而像 Moonshine 這樣的高度優化架構在形態豐富的非拉丁語言（如孟加拉語）上往往失敗。這項研究將這一失敗的根本原因確定為模型的英語中心字節級標記器，該標記器將孟加拉語單詞分割成高繁殖率的字節鏈，並在推理過程中引發災難性的自回歸崩潰。為了解決這個問題，提出了一種新穎的詞彙移植管道，旨在用本地腳本的 BanglaBERT WordPiece 詞彙替換解碼器詞彙，並調整相應的標記嵌入矩陣。實驗結果顯示，標記繁殖率從 9.16 降至 1.30。通過將自回歸序列長度減少 85.8%，解碼不穩定性得以完全緩解。在 882 小時的 Lipi-Ghor 數據集上進行評估時，修改後的架構達到了 21.54% 的競爭性字詞錯誤率 (WER) 和 0.0053 的實時因子 (RTF)。最終，這項研究提供了一個可擴展、可重複的藍圖，用於無需資源密集型預訓練的緊湊 ASR 模型的跨腳本適應。
2607.09598.author: Sanjid Hasan et.al.
